replay_modes.artifact_verification: Verify preserved inputs, configurations, code, outputs, audit events, and checksums without recomputation.
replay_modes.deterministic_packet_replay: Re-run P4-05 from the preserved P4-04 case state and compare recommendation, packet, updated case, and audit hashes.
replay_modes.full_pipeline_reexecution: Re-run P4-01 through P4-06 in the public repository. The actual Project 4 checkpoint under models/project4 is required for P4-03.

production_boundary: Controlled capstone prototype; nonbinding recommendations only; no autonomous external action; final human authority required.
